prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn patch_config(base: &[(&str,&str)], patches: &[(&str,&str,&str)]) -> Option<Vec<String>>
Behavior: Copy the base configuration, then apply patches in order. Each patch is (operation,key,value): set overwrites, unset removes even when absent and ignores value. Reject an empty key or unknown operation. Return sorted key=value strings without mutating base.
Visible example: base {mode=safe, zone=in} patched by unset zone then set mode=fast returns [mode=fast].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
pub fn patch_config(base:&[(&str,&str)],patches:&[(&str,&str,&str)])->Option<Vec<String>>{let mut m=BTreeMap::new();for &(k,v) in base{if k.is_empty(){return None}m.insert(k,v);}for &(op,k,v) in patches{if k.is_empty(){return None}match op{"set"=>{m.insert(k,v);},"unset"=>{m.remove(k);},_=>return None}}Some(m.into_iter().map(|(k,v)|format!("{k}={v}")).collect())}
